Mirabilia is a growing early childhood education provider committed to creating inspiring learning environments for children, families, and educators. As we continue to expand, we are looking for passionate and dedicated HR officer.

•	Human Resource Officer ($80,000 to $90,000/annum + superannuation)

At Mirabilia, we value teamwork, professionalism, innovation, and a genuine passion for supporting children and families within our community.

This is Permanent Full-time position!

Key responsibility
•	Coordinate recruitment and onboarding processes
•	Maintain HR records and employee documentation
•	Support employee relations and staff performance processes
•	Assist with training and professional development coordination
•	Support workplace compliance and HR administration
•	Work closely with management on staffing and workforce planning

Required Qualification & Work Experience
•	Previous experience in Human Resources or HR Administration - 1 year minimum
•	Bachelor qualification or above in HR, Business Administration, or related field
•	Strong understanding of Australian employment practices
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively
•	Experience in childcare or education sector highly regarded

Why Join Mirabilia?
•	Supportive and collaborative team culture
•	Professional development and career growth opportunities
•	Modern and well-resourced working environments
•	Competitive salary packages
•	Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the education sector

If you are passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a growing organisation, we would love to hear from you.

result.description:
Bestbar Pty Ltd has vacancies for Crane, Hoist and Lift Operators at their business based in Winnellie, NT.

This is a permanent, full-time position.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

To qualify this position, you will have
•	Certificate III in Mobile Crane Operations, or equivalent or relevant experience.
•	Minimum 1 years’ experience
•	Must be prepared to apply for appropriate high risk work licence from NT WorkSafe 
•	Testing the operation of plant before use to ensure safety
•	Operating controls to rotate cranes, move cranes on fixed rails and raise, lower and move hooks and objects
•	Working in conjunction with Riggers to position hooks and raise, move and place loads
•	Controlling the movement of loads, and monitoring speed, acceleration and braking distances directly and by signalling to other operators
•	Monitoring plant operation, instruments and gauges to detect malfunctions and problems
•	Lubricating ropes and winches on cranes and replacing worn cables
•	Operation of overhead cranes using hand controls suspended by cables from cranes


Remuneration/Salary
$79,000 - $85,000 per annum
Remuneration will reflect current market conditions and industry award rates. To be discussed with the successful applicant.

Application

Expressions of interest and applications will be accepted for at least 1 month from placement of this advertisement
result.title: Crane, Hoist and Lift Operators
